summary: Proceed, no companion: the sanctioned A1 split of the held combo-attn-master-sliding-race-skw-c16. On master both bands still run the FA3 chain (Sd32 FA3 18.6 us, Sv1 10.0 us). The risks are reading and safety: a scored submit returns no prepare log, and a sticky CUDA fault in an unchecked multi-thousand-line port cannot fall back.
justification: Collapsing each band to pre + one sk kernel could save ~8-14 us per row (weight 46 each; Sd32 is master's worst ratio 1.087x); headline ~1-1.5%, inside the CI, read per row. Weakest link: in-layer transfer on B=17..32 (sliding-cluster-c4-decode32-port and S1 class B both beat FA3 standalone and moved nothing in-layer; no griddepcontrol in the new kernels). Variant choice: attention's logs chose variant 4 at grid p8 for SV1, variant 6 at p4 for B=17..32. Prior missing: sliding-cluster-c4-decode32-port/-s2, sliding-fused-batched-decode-port, combo-attn-master-sliding-race-skw-c16 (A1).
confounders: combo-measured-rows-slide-batched-preattn-t8-tail: the selector must time against _attn_core as each state routes it; route skw before S1/S3.
small-t-launch-minimal-dense-chain-pdl / dense-chain-s3: new kernels lack griddepcontrol; time qkv GEMM through o-GEMM input.
full-decode-sk-ticket-restack-b1-b64 / dl3-piece-a: per-state tickets; give the new kernels distinct symbol names.
stack-align-par-sidestream-sliding1: Sd1 is the drift control.
interference: No companion; attribution per row (only Sd32 and Sv1 can change). Distinct kernel symbols (skw_attn_kernel, skw_pre_kernel) and an in-prepare variant x grid sub-race replace a second run.
rules_flags: k_scale/v_scale from device tensors; kv_scale fallback decided in prepare from config.
Config-only gate (page 1, window != 0, q_len, batch); whole 2048 window attended.
Safety: a canary illegal-address fault is sticky; the hypothesis says its first measurement is an okc check, and the parent builder held A1 for this reason.
Prepare budget: own start deadline from t_prepare0; master phases already use up to 260 of 300 s.
